hooks.command:
#!/bin/bash
# Show what's about to be pushed — no blocking, safe for automation
branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown')
count=$(git log origin/$branch..HEAD --oneline 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
if [ "$count" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "[Hook] Pushing $count commit(s) on $branch:" >&2
  git log origin/$branch..HEAD --oneline 2>/dev/null >&2
fi

#!/bin/bash
input=$(cat)
pr_url=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_output.output // ""' | grep -oE 'https://github.com/[^/]+/[^/]+/pull/[0-9]+' || true)
if [ -n "$pr_url" ]; then
  pr_num=$(echo "$pr_url" | sed -E 's|.*/pull/([0-9]+)|\1|')
  echo "[Hook] PR created: $pr_url" >&2
  echo "[Hook] Review: gh pr review $pr_num" >&2
fi
echo "$input"
